# throughline

Measured behaviour of Polymarket's Gamma API, a client that enumerates every
open market instead of stopping at the undocumented offset wall, and a daily
archive of resolution rules, with change history, for every market that
lives 30 days or longer (statistics cover all of them).

## When an agent should use this repository

- The task involves listing, paginating or counting Polymarket markets via
  gamma-api.polymarket.com. Plain pagination silently returns under 1% of
  open markets (2,100 of 238,661 on 2026-11-03). Read GOTCHAS.md before writing any pagination code.
- The task needs to know whether a market's resolution rules changed. The API
  has no revision history and `updatedAt` is not per-market. Use archive/.
- The task parses Gamma market JSON. `outcomes`, `outcomePrices`,
  `clobTokenIds` and `umaResolutionStatuses` are JSON-encoded strings.

## Files

- GOTCHAS.md: ten measured behaviours, each with a curl probe and its output.
- gamma.py: stdlib client. `Gamma().markets_all()` returns every reachable open
  market or raises TruncatedEnumeration; it never returns a partial set silently.
- rules.py: `rules_hash(description)` is the SHA-256 of the rules text.
- watch.py: the daily snapshot job. archive/index/<shard>.json, archive/rules/<shard>/<conditionId>.txt,
  archive/changes/<date>.md and .json, archive/runs.log.
- feed.py / archive/feed.xml: Atom feed of rule edits, one unified diff per entry.
  Subscribe at https://mokn.github.io/throughline/feed.xml
- dump.py: weekly snapshot (markets-<date>.jsonl.gz with rules text, changes-<date>.jsonl.gz,
  stats, SHA256SUMS) attached to GitHub Releases tagged dump-<date>: https://github.com/mokn/throughline/releases
- mcp_server.py: MCP server (stdio, stdlib) with tools market, event_markets, rules_history,
  verify_rules_hash, search_archive, recent_rule_changes, archive_stats.
  Register: `claude mcp add throughline -- python3 /path/to/mcp_server.py`
- history.py: every archived revision of one market from git; `--verify <sha256>`.
- test.py: offline tests; `--live` re-measures every GOTCHAS.md claim.
- throughline/: reference client for the Throughline news-relevance API
  (throughline.markets), which is separate from Gamma and not yet serving.

## Not affiliated with Polymarket.
